# Project Instructions

## General Rules

- Work with the existing codebase; do not rebuild it from scratch.
- Inspect the relevant files before editing.
- Preserve existing functionality, architecture, and design.
- Follow the repository's existing naming and folder conventions.
- Prefer small, focused, reviewable changes.
- Avoid unrelated changes and unnecessary dependencies.

## Development Process

- Explain the root cause when fixing bugs.
- For substantial changes, propose a plan before implementation.
- Check existing tests before writing new ones.
- Add or update tests for behavior changes.
- Run relevant tests, linting, type checks, and builds when available.
- Report commands that could not be run and why.

## Safety

- Preserve uncommitted changes.
- Never expose secrets or modify production data.
- Do not deploy, force-push, or execute destructive commands without approval.
- Never claim success without verification.

## Documentation

- Update documentation when behavior, configuration, or APIs change.
- Keep examples consistent with the actual implementation.
